e.title: insurance-covariate-shift
e.summary: 协变量漂移修正（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.4）：密度比修正，定价模型跨业务迁移
e.summary_en: Covariate shift correction (burning-cost, PyPI 0.1.4): density ratio correction for model portability across books
e.summary_hk: 協變量漂移修正（burning-cost，PyPI 0.1.4）：密度比修正，定價模型跨業務遷移
e.body: insurance-covariate-shift（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.4）做协变量漂移的密度比修正：定价模型跨业务组合迁移（新书 vs 旧书分布不同）时的重加权——模型可移植性。对 RIAA：模型迁移是保险实务常态（用旧书数据训练、部署到新书）——协变量漂移使模型失真；密度比修正（CatBoost/RuLSIF 估计）重加权训练数据；与 [[insurance-transfer]]（迁移学习）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移检测）配套；适合模型部署与迁移场景。
e.body_en: insurance-covariate-shift (burning-cost, PyPI v0.1.4) does density-ratio correction for covariate shift: reweighting when pricing models migrate across books (new vs old portfolio distributions differ) — model portability. For RIAA: model migration is the norm in practice (train on old book, deploy to new book) — covariate shift distorts models; density ratio correction (CatBoost/RuLSIF estimation) reweights training data; pairs with [[insurance-transfer]] (transfer learning) and [[insurance-monitoring]] (drift detection); suits model deployment and migration.
e.body_hk: insurance-covariate-shift（burning-cost，PyPI v0.1.4）做協變量漂移的密度比修正：定價模型跨業務組合遷移（新書 vs 舊書分佈不同）時的重加權——模型可移植性。對 RIAA：模型遷移是保險實務常態（用舊書數據訓練、部署到新書）——協變量漂移使模型失真；密度比修正（CatBoost/RuLSIF 估計）重加權訓練數據；與 [[insurance-transfer]]（遷移學習）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移檢測）配套；適合模型部署與遷移場景。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：PyPI v0.1.4 + GitHub README（家族成员），未实测
